# Beads issues with no description, which scripts/check-bead-descriptions.sh
# accepts.
#
# Generated by scripts/check-bead-descriptions.sh --update-baseline.
#
# An issue listed here does not fail the gate; an issue missing from here does.
# Every issue had a description when the gate landed, so an entry can only come
# from before that, and an empty one from now on is a description that was lost
# or never written.
#
# The update only drops entries: one whose description is back, and one the
# tracker no longer carries. It refuses to add one, because an entry records an
# empty description as accepted, which is the finding this gate names.
